clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: 1.   Scope —Requirements for manufacture, dimensions and tolerances, and marking, for injection moulded made of HDPE  ferrule reducers for potable water supplies.

clauses.title: Overall laying lengths and the tolerances
clauses.text: 2.1 Overall laying lengths and the tolerances thereon shall be as follows : Size Bends Laying Length mm mm 32 × 63 48 90 × 63 74.3 110 × 63 89.4 150 × 63 98.5 225 × 63 102.8 Note — For typical illustration of ferrule reducer see Fig.1 of the standard.

clauses.title: Outside diameter and wall
clauses.text: 2.2  Outside diameter and wall thickness of straight pipe portion at reducer end shall comply with the requirements given in IS 8008 (Part 1) : 2003. SUMMARY OF IS 8008 (PART 5) : 2003 INJECTION MOULDED HIGH DENSITY POLYETHYLENE (HDPE) FITTINGS FOR POTABLE WATER SUPPLIES PART 5 SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS FOR FERRULE REDUCERS (First Revision)
